purpose: Multi-objective burden comparison across the Science Owner's 4 candidate architecture classes (results/stage4_architecture_candidate_classes.json). No winner selected, no composite score computed.
explicit_non_goal: Does NOT compute TOTAL_SCORE = SCIENCE - MASS - POWER or any weighted composite. Does NOT select a final architecture.
derivation_note: frontal_eeg_only_derived (1.125 mW) = head_afe_eeg_eog.average_power_mw (1.5) - eog_incremental_power_mw (0.375), both already-published ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION values in results/stage4_engineering_readiness.json - a single disclosed subtraction, not a new measurement or a re-labeled datasheet fact.

classes.description: Only the sensors with TIER_A_REPLICATED_SUPPORT evidence.
sensors: chest ECG (as reference/ground-truth signal, not itself under incremental-value test)
classes.evidence_confidence: TIER_A for the PPG+IMU pairing; EEG/ECG themselves are foundation signals not under incremental-value test in this evidence set
classes.pending_science_exposure: NONE - this class does not depend on any HIGH-decision-sensitivity pending result.

power.note: Regulator efficiency (0.85) not applied here at the per-class level; see results/stage4_engineering_readiness.json for the system-level battery-side conversion. shared_infrastructure applies once regardless of class (every configuration needs one MCU+radio).

modules_required: chest_module (shares thoracic BioZ circuitry - see limitation)
mass.limitation: Module mass (wrist_module/chest_module/head_module/leg_module) is reported as a single per-module allowance in results/stage4_engineering_readiness.json and cannot be decomposed per sensor within a shared module (see results/stage4_gate_d_burden_completeness.json shared_resource_accounting.ecg_plus_thoracic_bioz). Where a class excludes a sensor that shares a module with an included sensor (e.g. MINIMAL_CORE excludes thoracic BioZ but includes ECG, both in chest_module), this comparison reports the FULL published module mass for every class that includes at least one sensor from that module, and flags the resulting mass figure BURDEN_DATA_INCOMPLETE for classes that would, in reality, have a smaller (but currently unquantifiable) module.

classes.dominance_reason: Tier-A evidence only; no HIGH-decision-sensitivity dependency; lowest sensor count.

classes.dominance_reason: leg BioZ adds a genuinely new body region + attachment/contact burden (leg_module, 8.431 g, excluded from every base total) for TIER_D_MIXED_OR_FRAGILE evidence (pareto_inputs incremental_value=MIXED, decision_fragility=HIGH); thoracic BioZ adds real, non-trivial power (1.33485 mW - one of the largest single contributors) for MIXED/negative-leaning evidence with no new body region. Per the Science Owner's own governing rule ('low burden does not transform weak evidence into strong evidence'), both warrant scrutiny; confirmed DOMINATED status requires Integration Owner's engineering burden confirmation (module-boundary, electrode counts) that Gate D has not yet closed.

classes.description: Evidence-Extended plus modalities with negative-leaning, unresolved, or entirely untested status - included only for explicit experimental/exploratory purposes, never presented as evidence-supported.
classes.evidence_confidence: TIER_E_NEGATIVE_OR_DEPRIORITIZED for second-site PPG; TIER_P_PENDING for wrist temperature/light
classes.pending_science_exposure: LOW for second-site PPG (no planned experiment); MEDIUM for wrist temperature/light (any new experiment would be informative given the complete absence of current evidence).

classes.dominance_reason: second-site PPG adds a new physical/optical sensing site with real burden (9.018 mW, 28500 bps - both larger than several already-included modalities) for a TIER_E_NEGATIVE_OR_DEPRIORITIZED, consistently-negative result (pareto_inputs incremental_value=NEGATIVE). Wrist temperature/light are TIER_P_PENDING with no governing experiment at all. This class is explicitly exploratory per the Science Owner's own candidate_classes.json, never evidence-supported.

note_on_dominance: PARETO_RELEVANT/POTENTIALLY_DOMINATED here are flags for further analysis, not final dominance rulings - GATE_D_BURDEN_COMPLETENESS is NOT_READY (results/stage4_gate_d_burden_completeness.json), so no configuration is confirmed DOMINATED.
